items.title: LIGHT
items.quote: Hashem is my light and my yeshuah.
items.text: Even when you are experiencing the darkness of anxiety and depression, look to Your bitachon in Hashem to find a source of light. Remember that your future is in His loving and capable hands. The yeshuah is sure to come.

items.w: אם תקום עלי מלחמה בזאת אני בוטח
items.quote: Even if a battle would be initiated against me, I would trust in this.

items.w: שבתי בבית יהוה כל ימי חיי
items.title: HASHEM’S HOUSE
items.quote: [One thing I have asked] that I dwell in the House of Hashem all the days of my life.
items.text: Ask Hashem to enable you to live in an environment where you can see Him and be close to Him.

items.title: SONGS OF PRAISE
items.quote: [There] will I sing and chant praise to Hashem.
items.text: Sing out your expressions of praise and gratitude to Hashem so that others will be inspired to follow suit.

items.w: שמע יהוה קולי אקרא וחנני וענני
items.title: TEFILLAH
items.quote: Hashem, hear my voice as I call. Favor me with Your kindness and answer me.
items.text: Speak to Hashem and ask Him to favor you with His kindness even though you are unworthy.

items.w: אל תסתר פניך ממני אל תט באף עבדך
items.quote: Don’t hide Your face from me, don’t turn away Your servant in anger.

items.w: הורני יהוה דרכך ונחני בארח מישור
items.title: GUIDANCE
items.quote: Teach me Your way, Hashem, and lead me on a level path.
items.text: Ask Hashem to guide you in making the right choices in life and put you in a situation where the choices are clear.

items.w: קוה אל יהוה חזק ויאמץ לבך וקוה אל יהוה
items.title: COURAGE
items.quote: Hope to Hashem; strengthen yourself and He will give your heart courage.
items.text: Even if you are facing difficult challenges, remember that Hashem is there with you and will help you do what is right.
